column1: # Consolidate isolated ranking/distribution leaves into the live window consumer.

column9: ROW_NUMBER now shares the canonical sorted-partition runtime consumed by Database::compute_window; Go allocator/sliding hooks remain partial.
RANK and DENSE_RANK now derive from one peer-start and dense-ordinal geometry instead of local match-arm cursors.
PERCENT_RANK now derives from the same peer starts as live RANK.
The isolated integer-key cursor is a compatibility facade; the live consumer derives CUME_DIST from canonical peer ends.
The five-field Ntile cursor is now the sole bucket arithmetic authority under Database::compute_window.
Stable physical positions now execute through the live SQL window consumer; Go memory/sliding hooks remain partial.
Gapped and dense ranks now execute through the canonical geometry and live consumer; Go memory assertions remain partial.
Peer-aware percentages now execute through the live consumer; Go memory assertions remain partial.
The facade and live consumer share canonical peer ends; Go chunk memory accounting remains partial.
The source cursor state now executes below the live SQL consumer; prepared/deferred constants and Go memory/chunk contracts remain partial.
